div.head: I Cn 15.1
div.ab: ⁊ huntaðfara ⁊ ealra woruldlicra weorca on þam halgan dæge geswícæ man georne.
⁊ huntaðfara ⁊ ealra woruldlicra weorca on þam halgan dæge geswice man georne.
And huntaðfara ⁊ ealra woruldlica weorca on ðam halgan dæge geswican man georne.
And huntaðfara ⁊ ealra woruldlica weorca on ðam halgan dæge geswican man georne.
And huntaðfara and ealra woruldlicra weorca on þam halgan dæge geswicæ man georne.
And hunting and all secular occupations shall be strictly abstained from on the holy day.
And hunts and worldly business are to be assiduously avoided on that holy day.
Und der Jagdzüge und aller weltlichen Arbeiten enthalte man sich willig an dem heiligen Tage.
And let hunting and all worldly work be eagerly given up on that holy day.
div.note: Quadr. includes this in 15 (‘uenationes et huiusmodi secularium actiones’). Liebermann compares VI Atr 22.1.; Robertson (p. 139) takes I Cn from B, which begins at ‘mæssedæg’ in 14.2, the earlier clauses being supplied from G
